verdict.rationale: The evidence implies card data stays off the merchant's servers: Paddle.js overlay checkout 'handles all parts of the checkout process', inline checkout is embedded via Paddle.js, and Paddle acts as merchant of record and holds the card on file for charging. None of the docs state this explicitly in PCI terms. Missing for 10: any explicit PCI DSS scope or SAQ documentation, any statement that card data is tokenized and never touches merchant servers, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
